title: Managing Type 2 Diabetes at Home — Spring Series
objective: Drive patients 55+ to book an annual wellness visit by teaching three at-home habits that improve A1C.
audience: Patients 55+, low health literacy, English and Spanish speakers
key_messages: Small daily habits move your A1C more than occasional big efforts
Your care team at PassQual can personalize a plan in one visit
Checking your feet and your numbers weekly prevents complications
tone: warm, plain-language, physician-led authority without jargon
